about: Population distributions used for the Population line and percentile bands on the dashboard (the athlete, Oct 23, 2026: real finisher or rider distributions, not standards). Each row: key, population, source, date, n, and breakpoints as [value, percentile from the front (share of the population faster/better than this value)]. Units match the marker. Public sources, generic terms; nothing of the athlete's was sent anywhere. Distance-level norms (all races of a distance) are the primary reference (the athlete, Oct 23); a race's own distribution is kept as a note where the course or field differs clearly. Trail ultras are the exception: courses differ so much that the race's own prior-year results, or similar courses, are the better reference. Rows may carry sex (male, female; missing = both sexes mixed), age_band (30-39; missing = all ages), short (the population in a few words for the tile) and tail (log for times and paces, else normal); coach/tools/fit_ladder.py picks the row for the athlete's sex and age band and builds the athlete's percentile ladder from it (Nov 8, 2026).
